description: 作文范文与仿写填空题库（人工审核版）。

samples.title: Unit 1 范文1：My Amazing Trip
samples.en: Last holiday, I went to Beijing with my parents. We climbed the Great Wall and took many photos. The view was amazing and we had a great time there.
samples.zh: 上个假期，我和父母去了北京。我们爬了长城并拍了很多照片。风景很棒，我们玩得很开心。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：We ___ the Great Wall and took many photos.

samples.title: Unit 1 范文2：A Visit to Xi'an
samples.en: Over the summer holidays, my family went to Xi'an. We visited the Terracotta Warriors and ate Xi'an noodles. It was an inspiring trip for me.
samples.zh: 暑假期间，我家去了西安。我们参观了兵马俑，还吃了西安面。这趟旅行很鼓舞我。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：We visited the Terracotta Warriors and ___ Xi'an noodles.

samples.title: Unit 1 范文3：Postcard to My Friend
samples.en: Hi Amy, I am in New Zealand now. Yesterday I visited the Gingerbread House. Please come here one day. I will send you more pictures.
samples.zh: 嗨，Amy，我现在在新西兰。昨天我参观了姜饼屋。希望你有一天也来。我会发给你更多照片。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I will ___ you more pictures.

samples.title: Unit 2 范文1：My Spring Festival
samples.en: The Spring Festival is my favourite festival. We cleaned the house, pasted fu on the door and had a big dinner. We also counted down to the new year.
samples.zh: 春节是我最喜欢的节日。我们打扫房子、贴福字、吃年夜饭，还倒计时迎接新年。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：We cleaned the house and ___ fu on the door.

samples.title: Unit 2 范文2：A Happy Mid-Autumn Festival
samples.en: On Mid-Autumn Festival, my family got together. We ate mooncakes and watched the moon. I talked with my grandparents and felt very happy.
samples.zh: 中秋节时，我们全家团聚。我们吃月饼、赏月。我和爷爷奶奶聊天，感到非常开心。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：We ___ mooncakes and watched the moon.

samples.title: Unit 2 范文3：Dragon Boat Day
samples.en: Last Dragon Boat Festival, we woke up early and watched the dragon boat race. My mother made zongzi and we cheered for the teams.
samples.zh: 上个端午节，我们早起看龙舟赛。妈妈包了粽子，我们为队伍加油。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：My mother ___ zongzi and we cheered for the teams.

samples.title: Unit 3 范文1：How to Keep Healthy
samples.en: We should have a healthy diet and exercise often. We shouldn't stay up late. If we feel ill, we should see a doctor in time.
samples.zh: 我们应该健康饮食并经常锻炼，不应熬夜。如果不舒服，应及时看医生。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：If we feel ill, we should ___ a doctor.

samples.title: Unit 3 范文2：My Healthy Plan
samples.en: I am going to run for twenty minutes every day. I will eat more vegetables and fruit. I am not going to drink too much cola.
samples.zh: 我打算每天跑步二十分钟。我会多吃蔬菜水果，不会喝太多可乐。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I am going to ___ for twenty minutes every day.

samples.title: Unit 3 范文3：A Visit to the Doctor
samples.en: Yesterday I had a fever and a cough. My mum took me to hospital. The doctor said I should drink warm water and get enough sleep.
samples.zh: 昨天我发烧并咳嗽。妈妈带我去了医院。医生说我应该喝温水并保证睡眠。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：The doctor said I should ___ warm water.

samples.title: Unit 4 范文1：My Pocket Money Plan
samples.en: I get pocket money every month. I save half of it first. Then I buy books and school things. I don't buy things I don't need.
samples.zh: 我每个月有零花钱。我先存下一半，然后买书和学习用品，不买不需要的东西。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I ___ half of my pocket money first.

samples.title: Unit 4 范文2：Smart Shopping
samples.en: I want a new schoolbag, but I will wait for a sale. I make a spending plan before shopping. It helps me use money wisely.
samples.zh: 我想要一个新书包，但我会等打折再买。购物前我会做花钱计划，这样能更合理用钱。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I will wait for a ___.

samples.title: Unit 4 范文3：Need and Want
samples.en: I need a dictionary for school, but I only want a toy car. I decide to buy the dictionary first. This is a better money plan.
samples.zh: 我需要一本词典上学用，但我只是想要玩具车。我决定先买词典，这是更好的用钱计划。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I ___ a dictionary for school.

samples.title: Unit 5 范文1：My Dream of Space
samples.en: I am interested in space. There are many planets in the solar system. I want to be an astronaut in the future.
samples.zh: 我对太空感兴趣。太阳系有很多行星。未来我想成为宇航员。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I want to be an ___ in the future.

samples.title: Unit 5 范文2：A Visit to a Space Museum
samples.en: Last weekend, I visited a space museum. I saw a big rocket and learned about Mars rovers. The trip was exciting.
samples.zh: 上周末我参观了太空博物馆。我看到了大火箭，还了解了火星探测器。这次旅行非常刺激。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：I ___ a big rocket in the museum.

samples.title: Unit 5 范文3：Exploring Mars
samples.en: China sent a rover to Mars. It can take pictures and study the soil. I am proud of our space science.
samples.zh: 中国向火星发射了探测器。它可以拍照并研究土壤。我为我们的航天科技感到自豪。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：China ___ a rover to Mars.

samples.title: Unit 6 范文1：Save Energy Every Day
samples.en: We should save energy every day. We should turn off lights when we leave a room and unplug computers.
samples.zh: 我们应该每天节约能源。离开房间时要关灯，并拔掉电脑插头。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：We should ___ off lights when we leave.

samples.title: Unit 6 范文2：Green Energy
samples.en: Solar power and wind power are green energy. They are clean and helpful for our Earth. We should use more green energy.
samples.zh: 太阳能和风能是绿色能源。它们清洁环保，对地球有帮助。我们应该多用绿色能源。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：Solar power and wind power are ___ energy.

samples.title: Unit 6 范文3：3R Rules
samples.en: To protect the Earth, we should reduce, reuse and recycle. I reuse my school bags and recycle paper bottles at school.
samples.zh: 为了保护地球，我们应减少、重复使用和回收。我会重复使用书包，并在学校回收纸和瓶子。
samples.fillPrompt: 填空：We should reduce, ___ and recycle.
